title: Cod with dill and mustard sauce, potatoes and peas
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18–20 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Salt the cod and fry it in a pan with the butter over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side.
Stir the yoghurt with the mustard, chopped dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve the fish with the potatoes, peas and dill-mustard sauce.
